The key finding of this study is that nurses who work on an intensive care unit (ICU) are at high risk of experiencing stress and that the stress they experience is associated with a number of factors including: (a) the type of patient care provided on the unit, (b) the nature of the patient population, and (c) the organizational environment of the unit.
